metadata.title: ISCO-08 Worldwide National Adaptations and Translations
metadata.description: Cross-reference of ISCO-08 (International Standard Classification of Occupations 2008) translations and national adaptations worldwide
metadata.methodology: Web research of national statistical offices, ILO resources, and ESCO API

ILO_ISCO08.notes: Official ILO standard. Available in EN/FR/ES. Arabic version announced as 'coming soon'.

ESCO.format: API + CSV + RDF + TTL + ODS + XML + JSON-LD
ESCO.notes: EU official. 28 languages including Arabic, Icelandic, Norwegian Bokmal, Ukrainian. Each occupation mapped to exactly one ISCO-08 code.

KBJI_2014_Indonesia.notes: Klasifikasi Baku Jabatan Indonesia 2014. Direct ISCO-08 adaptation.

MASCO_2020_Malaysia.notes: Malaysia Standard Classification of Occupations 2020. Bilingual Malay/English.

PSOC_2012_Philippines.notes: Philippine Standard Occupational Classification 2012. English only, no Filipino/Tagalog labels.

JSOC_Japan.authority: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (総務省)
JSOC_Japan.notes: 日本標準職業分類 (Nihon Hyojun Shokugyo Bunrui). Set December 2009. Uses own code structure, not 1:1 ISCO-08 mapping.

KSCO_Korea.notes: 한국표준직업분류 (KSCO) 7th revision, effective 2018-01-01. Own code structure with ISCO mapping. 8th revision effective 2025.

GB_T_6565_China.authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security + National Bureau of Statistics
GB_T_6565_China.notes: 中华人民共和国职业分类大典 (2022 edition). 8 major categories, own coding. Not direct ISCO-08 mapping.

NCO_2015_India.notes: National Classification of Occupations 2015. English only, no Hindi labels in official docs. Compatible with ISCO-08.

TSCO_Thailand.authority: Department of Employment (กรมการจัดหางาน) + NSO
TSCO_Thailand.notes: การจัดประเภทมาตรฐานอาชีพประเทศไทย. TSCO 2001 based on ISCO-88. NSO created ISCO-08 Thai translation in 2022.

SINCO_Mexico.notes: Sistema Nacional de Clasificación de Ocupaciones 2019. Own code structure, not direct ISCO-08 mapping.

CBO_Brazil.notes: Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações. Based on ISCO-88 (not 08). Own 4-digit code structure.

CUOC_Colombia.notes: Clasificación Única de Ocupaciones para Colombia (CUOC 2025). Adapted from CIUO/ISCO-08 via Decree 654/2021.

CNO_Argentina.notes: Clasificador Nacional de Ocupaciones. Own code structure, not direct ISCO-08 mapping.

SOC_2018_USA.based_on: Own system (crosswalk to ISCO available for 2010 SOC)
SOC_2018_USA.notes: Standard Occupational Classification 2018. Own 6-digit code system. SOC 2010 to ISCO-08 crosswalk exists.

NOC_2021_Canada.based_on: Own system (NOC 2021 to ISCO-08 crosswalk planned)
NOC_2021_Canada.notes: National Occupational Classification 2021 v1.0. Bilingual EN/FR. Own 5-digit system. ISCO-08 crosswalk planned.

SSCO_Saudi_Arabia.notes: Saudi Standard Classification of Occupations (SSCO). 5-level hierarchy based on ISCO-08. Arabic.

ISCO_TR_Turkey.notes: TÜİK uses ISCO-08 directly. TMSS 2020 (Türkiye Meslek Sınıflama Sistemi) is draft national adaptation.

OKZ_Russia.notes: ОК 010-2014 (МСКЗ-08). Общероссийский классификатор занятий. Direct ISCO-08 Russian translation. Effective 2015-07-01.

NKZ_Kazakhstan.authority: Committee on Technical Regulation and Metrology
NKZ_Kazakhstan.notes: НК РК 01-2017 Классификатор занятий. Based on ISCO-08. Kazakh and Russian. Effective 2017.

SASCO_South_Africa.notes: SASCO 2012 based on ISCO-88. Now replaced by OFO (Organising Framework for Occupations) based on ANZSCO. English only.

KeSCO_Kenya.notes: Kenya Standard Classification of Occupations 2022. English only, no Swahili labels.

TASCO_Tanzania.notes: Tanzania Standard Classification of Occupations. Uses ISCO-08 directly. English.

PSCO_Pakistan.notes: Pakistan Standard Classification of Occupations 2015. 5-digit extension of ISCO-08. English only.

BSCO_Bangladesh.notes: Bangladesh Standard Classification of Occupations (BSCO) 2020. Download from BBS website.

Israel_CBS.notes: Israel has own occupation classification. ISCO-88 crosswalk exists. ISCOIL Stata module converts CBS codes to ISCO-08.

Iran_SCI.authority: Statistical Center of Iran (مرکز آمار ایران)
Iran_SCI.notes: طبقه بندی استاندارد مشاغل ایران 1395. Iran uses ISCO-08 for national surveys. Farsi occupation labels used in census data.

ANZSCO_Australia_NZ.authority: ABS (Australian Bureau of Statistics) + Stats NZ
ANZSCO_Australia_NZ.notes: Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations 2022. Own 6-digit code. ANZSCO-to-ISCO crosswalk available.

SOC_2020_UK.based_on: Own system (SOC 2020 to ISCO-08 crosswalk available)
SOC_2020_UK.notes: UK Standard Occupational Classification 2020. 9 major groups, 26 sub-major, 104 minor, 412 unit groups.

KldB_2010_Germany.based_on: Own system (5-digit, crosswalk to ISCO-08 available)
KldB_2010_Germany.notes: Klassifikation der Berufe 2010 (revised 2020). 5-digit system with crosswalk from KldB to ISCO-08 4-digit level.

CH_ISCO_19_Switzerland.notes: Schweizer Berufsnomenklatur CH-ISCO-19. ISCO-08 base + Swiss 5th level. Available in DE/FR/IT.

Ethiopia_CSA.authority: CSA (Central Statistical Agency / Ethiopian Statistical Service)
Ethiopia_CSA.notes: Ethiopia uses ISCO-08 for census and surveys. English publication. No known Amharic standalone classifier published online.

VSCO_Vietnam.notes: Vietnam Standard Classification of Occupations (VSCO). 4-digit level aligned with ISCO-08. Vietnamese labels in census microdata.

Nigeria_NBS.notes: Nigeria uses ISCO-08 directly for Labour Force Survey. English only. No known national adaptation published.

language_summary.notes: Many countries (India, Pakistan, Kenya, Tanzania, Philippines) use ISCO-08 in English only, without translating occupation labels into local languages. Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, Amharic translations may exist in census microdata but are not published as standalone classifiers.

our_9_languages_coverage._note: Coverage assessment for hypothetical 9 target languages

cross_reference_notes.key_finding: ESCO is the single richest source: 28 languages, all 436 ISCO-08 unit groups, machine-readable API+CSV. For non-European languages, each country must be researched individually. Most developing countries adopted ISCO-08 codes directly but publish only in English.
